reasoning: Nevada’s current Senate race appears slightly Republican-leaning based on a recent poll tracker averaging five polls showing Sam Brown ahead by 1 point. I did not find any reliable, last-45-days presidential race polling for Nevada in the provided results, so the Senate polling is the best available current-margin indicator here; Nevada’s statewide Cook PVI is R+2, which I translate to D+2 only if using a Democratic-lean convention is inappropriate, so I am reporting the structural index as R+2 from the Cook benchmark.
